subject: lightining,expression: support user variable for `BuildSimpleExpr` and remove `PlanContext` dependency in lightning context (#55617)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs parent: planner `expressionRewriter` now rewrites user variables without `PlanContext` by requiring `OptPropSessionVars` in `EvalContext` (system variables still require `planCtx`), executor/importer KV encoding switches SET-clause expr building to `expression.BuildSimpleExpr` (`GetExprCtx()`), and `SessionVars` now implements `SessionVarsProvider` to support optional-prop injection. Confirmed session eval contexts provide `OptPropSessionVars`, and DDL validators still explicitly reject `*ast.VariableExpr` in persisted expressions (generated columns/partition/check constraints), so expanded `BuildSimpleExpr` support doesn’t open correctness/data-consistency holes. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the scoped areas.
